A one-line notice with its consequence and at most two actions. It times out after six seconds with a visible timer; errors persist until dismissed. Toasts sit at the bottom right, or full width at the bottom on phones.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** Not drawn by `.polarisKeyGate`: a host places `ToastView` itself. The gate's sign-in form ends by saying who signed in ("Signed in as …") in its own body.

    **Styled part.** `ToastView(text:tone:)` on a floating glass surface.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.toast(_:)`: an error toast stays until dismissed.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<Toast />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<Toast />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("Toast", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** The gate places its own toasts ("Signed in as …", "Copied"); other toasts are yours to place.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisToast(message, kind, detail, actions)`, or `PolarisToastHost(spec, onDismiss)` over a `PolarisToastSpec`. Info, success and warning toasts time out after six seconds with a visible timer; an error stays until an action answers it.

    **Headless.** `PolarisToastSpec` and `KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.toast, inputs)`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisToastAction
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisToastHost
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisToastKind
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisToastSpec

    @Composable
    fun MyToast(shown: Boolean, undo: () -> Unit, dismiss: () -> Unit) {
        val spec = PolarisToastSpec(
            message = "Device removed",
            kind = PolarisToastKind.Success,
            actions = listOf(PolarisToastAction("Undo", undo)),
        )
        PolarisToastHost(spec.takeIf { shown }, onDismiss = dismiss)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.

  </TabItem>
